1. Your husband *must* change his address on his teudat zehut. If he doesn't, it is going to cause problems at your next renewal meeting (they will see that your bills and on your rent contract that you are living at a different address to the one registered). He can do this online if he hasn't changed it in the past year, and then he should email the visa departments of both Hadera and Ramat Gan to let them know of the move. You don't need to update your address - you can do this at the meeting. 

2. The "center of life" rule (which generally is interpreted as being 75% of a year) is  applied to each visa year - it is something PIBA checks every time you renew. 

3. You husband should update it ASAP. There is a also a chance that they will keep your file in Hadera anyway (sometimes they do this when a couple is well advanced in the process, like you are). But you should let them make this choice. October is still a while away, so if you update now (and send the emails), and they do transfer, then there is enough time that things should be smooth. 

More generally, you say your visa expired in May but that your appointment is in October. Just checking that you do have a valid visa at the moment - maybe you received one of the automatic extensions as part of the war? It is important that you are not here without a valid visa :)
